title: Habitat/dispersal determinism hygiene (§4.48)
simLoop: habitatProcess now declares terrain.elevation and soil.material, both silently consumed inside runHabitatStep. Five new registered fields (veg.hsi.{strand,binder,marsh,shrub,crust}) are the single place runDispersalStep computes each guild's raw HSI; runHerbEstablishmentStep reads that annual snapshot instead of recomputing it every seasonal tick. runHerbEstablishmentStep is restructured guild-major (outer loop over an explicit, parametrizable guild order, inner loop over cells) so every guild's update reads only its own seed/biomass/HSI arrays — the same-tick cross-guild read that made the update order-dependent no longer exists.
gameLoop: A shrub thicket or crust patch reads how suitable last year's conditions actually were, not a number quietly recomputed mid-season off whatever the meadow happened to be doing that week — the displayed establishment odds and what actually grew the guild can no longer silently disagree.
notebookSeed: A shrub thicket reads how thick last year's meadow already was, not how thick it happens to be right now, mid-season, while it's still filling in.
tierO: no owner-only question — order-independence and the declared-reads fix are CI-judged (guildEstablishmentOrder.test.ts); D-007 clip gate does not apply (no new Process). Track R has no further executable item after this ships — remaining vegetation/habitat work (C-023 guild competition) stays owner-gated behind L2/L3, off tip.
